Title: LSJ-Timing of Cat's Guidance and Coordinate Attack

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Is there a specific order of play that allows a blocking vampire to untap
with Cat's Guidance then have another vampire play Coordinate Attack?

--
Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr.

Archon of the Swamp

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:
>
> Is there a specific order of play that allows a blocking vampire to untap
> with Cat's Guidance then have another vampire play Coordinate Attack?

No, since CA is a combat card (see also Psyche!).
But he could play Cats after the Coordinated combat.

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
"XZealot" <x_ze...@cox-internet.com> wrote in message news:v1p3ulq...@corp.supernews.com...

[re Hidden Lurker and Cat's Guidance]

> I thought that this was one of those minutae rulings where the since the
> combat after the block had ceased to occur and another combat had started
> that you couldn't play Cat's Guidance.
>
> I am happy I was mistaken.

You might have been thinking of Hidden Lurker vs Fast Reaction -
since Fast Reaction specifies that it's played after a combat
between a blocking and an acting minion, it can't be played if
the acting Meth has played Hidden Lurker.

Then again, maybe not. :-)

Josh
